schema: graduation evidence v1. One entry per factory day. Each of the five §16 clauses carries holds (bool), a non-empty artifact citation (where it was read from), and read_as (the standard it was read under). A factory day absent here, or any clause without a citation, is UNPROVEN and cannot be part of a clean run (#94 point 7). Clause 2 ('different shifts') and cross-repo clause-3 shas are hand assertions the tool flags 'verify by hand' (§10 carries no shift/run id — #94 point 8); a factory-hub sha is additionally resolved against the hub repo. This file is deliberately partial: v0 seeds only days whose artifacts are quotable. The verdict is the by-hand audit's assistant, never its replacement (§16).
